title: 第13章 帮凶张教授-《开局三预言？我直播通关S级末世》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “靳兰玦！你不要吓唬我，我也是被迫的，我就这么一个儿子，就这么一个儿子……

    你们都来拿捏我……小小他做错了什么……”

    张教授肯定知道更多东西，所以他的神经脆弱得像一根蚕丝，说断就断。

    靳兰玦在他的表情里发现了端倪，问：

    “是不是靳业平利用小小威胁你来害我的？”

    一语惊醒梦中人。

    张教授的失控瞬间凝滞，他看着靳兰玦，双眼含泪，嘴唇颤抖：

    “别怪我……兰玦，你是老师最喜欢的学生，你别怪老师，为了我的小小……

    对不起，对不起……”

    靳兰玦定定看着眼前痛哭流涕的老师，表情凝滞。

    这是她曾经最崇敬的老师。

    为了自己的孩子，他还是会把另一位孩子推入深渊。

    她能理解，但是她不会原谅。

    靳兰玦缓缓闭了闭眼，像是困极了。

    她靠着椅子，眼帘垂着，声音有点含混：

    “就算、靳业平在也、没用……你还是……快点……”

    然后，她彻底闭上眼睛，睡死过去。

    张教授崩溃，绕过桌子捏住靳兰玦的肩膀用力摇晃：

    “快点干什么？我要怎么做？你说完啊靳兰玦！！！”

    可惜，他下的药他心里清楚，靳兰玦这一睡过去，没有十个小时不可能醒。

    后门被人推开。

    一个光头上面纹身的大汉抹了把光头，走近查看：

    “才倒？你他妈的老白脸做事就是不靠谱，害老子跟兄弟们等这么久……

    呦，长这么漂亮，靳建国那个老贼真舍得把这娇娇小姐卖去山里给人生崽啊？

    嘶……实在不行，跟着老子也不是不行……”

    光头说着，就要伸手去捏靳兰玦的下巴。

    张教授横过一步，挡在两人之前。

    光头挑眉：“哦？”

    张教授战战兢兢：

    “你们只负责把人安安全全送过去，你不能有其他的行为……”

    “其他行为？怎么算其他行为？哥们儿吃不了，摸一把还不行？”光头邪肆大笑，“就是啃一口也是可以的嘛哈哈哈哈……”

    张教授的脸瞬间憋得通红，结结巴巴反驳：

    “不行！不、这不对……”
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

"Jin Lanjue! Don't scare me, I am also forced to do it. I am just such a son, just such a son...

You all come and pick on me...he did something wrong..."

Professor Zhang must know more, so his nerves are as fragile as silk, which can be broken at any time.

Jin Lanjue found clues in his expression and asked:

"Did Jin Yeping use a small threat to harm you to harm me?"

One word wakes up the dreamer.

Professor Zhang’s loss of control froze for a moment. He looked at Jin Lanjue with tears in his eyes and trembling lips:

"Don't blame me...Lan Jue, you are the teacher's favorite student, don't blame the teacher, for my little...

Sorry, sorry..."

Jin Lanjue stared at the crying teacher in front of him, his expression stagnant.

This is the teacher she respected the most.

For the sake of his own child, he will still push another child into the abyss.

She can understand, but she won’t forgive.

Jin Lanjue slowly closed his eyes, as if he was extremely sleepy.

She leaned back on the chair, her eyes were lowered, and her voice was a little vague:

"Even if Jin Yeping is here, it's useless...you still...hurry up..."

Then, she closed her eyes completely and fell asleep.

Professor Zhang collapsed, walked around the table, pinched Jin Lanjue’s shoulders and shook him hard:

"What are you doing quickly? What should I do? Finish your sentence, Jin Lanjue!!!"

"It's a pity that he knew the medicine he administered. Once Jin Lanjue fell asleep, he wouldn't be able to wake up for less than ten hours."

The back door was pushed open.

A big man with tattoos on his bald head wiped his bald head and walked closer to check:

"You just failed? You damn old fool is so unreliable that you made me and my brothers wait for so long...

"Hey, with such beauty, that old thief Jin Jianguo is really willing to sell this charming lady to the mountains to give birth to cubs?"

… It’s really not possible, but it’s not impossible to follow me…”

As the bald man spoke, he reached out to pinch Jin Lanjue's chin.

Professor Zhang took a step across and stood in front of the two of them.

The bald man raised his eyebrows: "Oh?"

Professor Zhang was trembling:

"You are only responsible for sending people there safely, you cannot do anything else..."

"Other behaviors? How can we count them as other behaviors? I can't eat it, so I can't touch it?" The bald head laughed evilly, "It's okay even to take a bite, hahahaha..."

Professor Zhang’s face turned red instantly, and he stammered in retort:

"No! No, this isn't right..."
